title: Beethoven Symphony No 9 Choral CD Bernstein Vienna Time Life Deutsche Gram
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Ludwig van Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125 (Choral).
The Beethoven Collection, Time-Life Music / Deutsche Grammophon, BTD-01B.
Made for Time-Life Music in West Germany.

Gwyneth Jones, soprano; Hanna Schwarz, contralto; Rene Kollo, tenor;
Kurt Moll, bass; Concert Chorus of the Vienna State Opera; Vienna
Philharmonic Orchestra; Leonard Bernstein, conductor.

1. Allegro ma non troppo, un poco maestoso (15:19)
2. Molto vivace (11:15)
3. Adagio molto e cantabile (17:49)
4. Presto (7:46)
5. Presto; Allegro assai (18:43)

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
